text:
Sara (Sales): FYI we kicked off a POC with MonolithAI today. They want to migrate off their current vendor and expect API parity for streaming + function-calls. Asking for a BOM, pricing estimate, and security questionnaire answers. Can SEs help scope?

Ajay (SE): Happy to. Do we have a list of their endpoints/features they rely on (streaming, tool-calls, assistant/chat, embeddings)?

Sara (Sales): Yes — streaming chat w/ early-stop, function-calls (json schema outputs), embeddings for search, and a custom rate-limit header. Also they surface partial tokens for streaming clients.

Mike (Solutions Eng): For parity we typically build a tiny adapter shim that maps their SDK->Redwood. Keeps prompt templates identical and normalizes responses.

Ajay (SE): Example mapping we can drop in their proxy:```json
{
  "requests": {
    "stream": "true",
    "max_tokens": "client_max_tokens",
    "tool_call": "function_call"
  },
  "response_map": {
    "choices[0].delta": "stream.chunk",
    "choices[0].message": "final.message"
  }
}
```

Ajay (SE): If they need token-level streaming be careful: our streaming frames differ slightly (we send incremental text + metadata). We can emit the same partial-token framing at the proxy level but it adds ~30–50ms processing per request.

Mike (Solutions Eng): Pricing: quick gut — small POC (10k tokens/day) fine on Hosted: ~$0.5–1k/mo. If they want deterministic latency or reserved concurrency for production, propose Dedicated (committed GPUs) — pricing depends on commit; ballpark $10k–25k/mo for customer-grade throughput. We'll do a more exact BOM once we know model selection + batch configs.

Zara (Security): I need the standard questionnaire items: SOC2 report, encryption in transit+at rest, key management (KMS/HSM), VPC peering options, and data retention policy. Also ask if they require on-prem or air-gapped.

devops-bot: Created repo redwood-pocs/monolith-migration-1915007777 and added everyone.

Sara (Sales): @Ajay @Mike can you please add a short test harness (1) prompt set for parity checks and (2) a tiny client that exercises streaming+function calls? Target: deliver within 7 business days.

Ajay (SE): Yep. I'll add a harness and a sample prompt set. For parity checks we should include: prompt echoes, tool-call edge cases (missing args), truncated streams, and high-token responses.

Mike (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the BOM: model variants (base, quantized), expected GPUs, bandwidth, and per-route routing to handle fallback to cheaper models during burst. Also include optional A/B canary plan.

Zara (Security): I'll prepare the security answers and request their DPA + basic legal contacts. If they need SOC2 evidence we'll share our report via secure link.

Sara (Sales): Monolith needs an estimate on delta in responses vs current vendor — they're particularly sensitive to small JSON formatting differences from function-calls.

Ajay (SE): For JSON delta we can do a normalization layer that enforces schema and whitespace/ordering; we also include a quick regression harness that computes diffs and a per-prompt fail-rate. Expect small diffs in whitespace or calling name but we can normalize 95% of cases.

Mike (Solutions Eng): Action list: 1) Ajay — adapter shim + harness (ETA 7d). 2) Mike — BOM + pricing PDF (ETA 3 business days). 3) Zara — security questionnaire and DPA path (ETA 2 business days). 4) Sara — coordinate legal + procurement contacts and confirm SSO/SAML needs.

Sara (Sales): Nice. Can we also include a fallback plan if they hit a behavior regression in the POC? We want a fast rollback path.

Ajay (SE): We'll wire an automatic fallback to a baseline model variant and route to their old API via proxy if we detect >X% fail rate. I'll add config for canary thresholds.

Mike (Solutions Eng): I'll add pricing for a short rollback support window and a runbook for fallback.

Sara (Sales): Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: I'll update the customer and set a 30-min kickoff with Monolith and their engineering next Tue.

Zara (Security): Noted, I'll join the kickoff to walk through the questionnaire items.

Ajay (SE): Logged. Starting the shim tonight.

Mike (Solutions Eng): I'll upload the BOM to the repo and tag the PR.

Sara (Sales): Great — closing this thread for now, will post the kickoff link in the repo.
